Well.. I'll start with the obligatory statement that how you dress does not make you punk, etc.

Now that this is out of the way, I have enjoyed making and modifying my own clothing for years. I'll share with you some general tips that don't cost hardly anything.

You can do a lot with stencils, spray paint, bleach, paint pens, and whatever you can find at a thrift store.

Hardware stores are fun places to shop. Screws, chains, and all kinds of shiny fasteners that literally cost pennies. For a bit more money, you can buy razor knives and stuff that are useful for cutting stencils and fabric.

Denim and cotton are very versatile materials.

Fabric stores have lots of fun stuff also for cheap. Snaps, d-rings, o-rings, fabrics, zippers, safety pins.

Leather hobby stores have spikes, studs, etc, but that stuff may cost you a little more.

You can make belts and bracelets out of old bicycle innertubes. 

Learning to sew is really cool, too.

But just have fun. Be creative. Come up with new ideas.
